summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by KB Financial Group Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its preliminary consolidated operating results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026. The filing includes key financial figures for KB Financial Group, Kookmin Bank, and KB Securities, prepared under K-IFRS. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard earnings release, not a special situation.
